entries.test: Public evaluations of a demonstrated AGI would show whether it achieved general intelligence without solving abstraction, compositionality, or the type-token distinction.
entries.note: The core claim makes these capabilities necessary for AGI. The remark about pictures and conversation is background, not an additional antecedent.

entries.test: The cited study's methods and results, compared with early neural-network research, would establish whether new measures and a new model exhibit the same compositionality limitation.
entries.note: The surrounding text identifies the stumbling block as compositionality. The supplied text omits the study's abstract and identifying details.

entries.test: The cited criticisms and published evaluations available by February 2023 would show whether contemporary models retained previously documented problems with abstraction, compositionality, or related limitations.
entries.note: “Today” refers to the publication date. He claims persistence of some historical problems, not every problem.

entries.test: Historical accounts of graduate-student programming and public reporting on outsourced AI training labor, its working conditions, and its corrective role would test the asserted shift in human handcrafting.
entries.note: He hedges how much overall reliance on hacks has changed, but firmly asserts the outsourcing exception. “Sweatshops” has a factual reading concerning labor conditions.
